newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's short-term PHIBOR rates higher.
newsitem.headline: Manila's short-term PHIBOR rates higher.

text.p: Short-term Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) rose on Friday in anticipation of a tightness in liquidity in case the central bank made further moves to defend the peso, traders said.
The one-week to three-month rates were higher, while the six to 12-month rates were lower.
"The view is that the central bank will keep overnight rates. But then, there's the possibility it will raise liquidity reserves to protect the peso," a foreign bank dealer said.
The peso fell to a low of 29.85 to dollar in morning deals in reaction to the malaise in the region's currencies.
